topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: Well, now, I heard tell of a peculiar thing, the likes of which I've never seen in all my years tending the soil. Seems a painter from the city, a man who twirls his colors on canvas like a summer breeze, found his work inked on the very skin of a man. A stranger, they say, who wandered through the market and showed no shame. The painter, he just stood there, brush in hand, and stared. Some say he was angry, but from what I hear, he just nodded his head, as if he understood the earth turning in its own way. People do strange things, don’t they? Just as strange as the rains that come and go without a word.
